negative_controls.description: PASS -> attempt -> no result materialized => STOP_RECERT_ATTEMPT_OPEN (the earlier PASS is suspended).
PASS -> attempt -> FAIL, BLOCKED or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE => STOP_CERTIFICATION_REVOKED; a sibling-SHA FAIL with the same digest revokes; FAIL then PASS => STOP_CONTRADICTORY_CERTIFICATION.
merge -s ours dropping a FAIL, and dropping an attempt with its FAIL together => STOP_ADJUDICATION_HISTORY_VIOLATED (the second case is caught by the ever-added rule alone).
Ever-added history on real DAGs: normal merge + git rm, evil merge, add/add, delete and restart, modify, rename, zero adds, executable add, unexpected raw output.

Git rewrites: a loose object forged under its own id (detected only by git fsck --full; review B1), replace refs (log and ls-tree), info/grafts (including one hiding a deletion), a forged commit-graph, a repository log.showRoot=false, an alias, included configuration and a hostile inherited environment are defeated; a shallow clone is UNVERIFIABLE.
